name: BINGO
description: Bingo is a historic domino trick-taking game for 2 players based on the card game Sixty-Six. Hailed as the 'king of domino games' in 19th-century America, it features a unique hierarchy where the double-blank tile, named 'Bingo', is the supreme trump. Players win tricks to collect point-values from the tiles, aiming to reach 70 points and claim the deal. This game predates the popular lottery-style Bingo and represents a high-skill adaptation of card mechanics to dominoes.

content.text: Bingo is a historic domino trick-taking game for 2 players based on the card game Sixty-Six. Hailed as the 'king of domino games' in 19th-century America, it features a unique hierarchy where the double-blank tile, named 'Bingo', is the supreme trump. Players win tricks to collect point-values from the tiles, aiming to reach 70 points and claim the deal. This game predates the popular lottery-style Bingo and represents a high-skill adaptation of card mechanics to dominoes.

Developed in 19th-century America as a response to religious prohibitions on playing cards. Trick-taking card games like Sixty-Six were adapted to use domino tiles, with 'Bingo' emerging as the most complex and respected of these variants.
Tiles are shuffled face-down. Each player draws 7 tiles. The remaining 14 tiles form the face-down stock.

items.text: Single Point Bingo: A simplified version where every deal is worth exactly 1 point, ignoring the margin of victory.
